narrative.overview: The ward's monsoon money trail is set as an official government file. A khaki file-cover band with a red-tape rule sits on top; noting-sheet green panels lie on a paler board; a violet stamp-pad ink marks what the committee must answer. Every number reads as a matter on the record, not as a KPI tile.
keyCharacteristics: Khaki shell band and red-tape rule frame the page; sheets are green-tinted paper on a paler board.
One violet reserved for flags and committee matters; red only for over budget and failed; green only for money that held.
Archivo carries all UI and every large numeral (tabular); Courier Prime only for ids and file marks.
Depth is a 1px sage rule, not a shadow.
Dark mode is a night-office version of the same file, shell kept khaki.

rules.name: The One Job Rule
rules.body: Violet means flag or committee; red means over budget or failed; green means held. No colour borrows another's job, and none is decorative.

rules.name: The Four-Segment Ramp Rule
rules.body: The Rs100 register bar is exactly four segments: held (green), failed within 30 days (ink), overbilled (amber), billed twice (red). New data categories do not get a fifth hue.

rules.name: The Tinted Ink Rule
rules.body: Text greys are olive-tinted inks (`ink-secondary`, `ink-tertiary`), never neutral grey. All corporator styles read the `--f-*` tokens in `tokens.css`; no hard-coded colours.

rules.name: The Typewriter Only Rule
rules.body: Courier Prime appears only on file numbers, work-order and complaint ids, source chips, annexure letters and the file-movement trail. Never for prose or headings.

rules.name: The Big Numeral Rule
rules.body: Key figures are set at 3.25rem or larger (answer-card KPIs clamp 3.25 to 4.5rem) in weight 800 with tight tracking (-0.04em).

rules.name: The Single Elevation Rule
rules.body: The sheet is the only elevation: a ruled 1px border at rest. Hover and selection change fill, outline or brightness; they do not lift.

dos: Do read every colour from the `--f-*` tokens in `src/pages/corporator/tokens.css`; add dark-mode values alongside any new token.
Do keep violet for flags and committee matters, red for over budget and failed, green for held.
Do separate surfaces with the 1px sage rule on a noting-sheet fill, and use the 4px spacing scale.
Do set ids and file numbers in Courier Prime and everything else in Archivo with tabular numerals.
Do keep controls as standard web controls with the 2px violet focus-visible outline.
Do word flags as questions for the committee (PRODUCT.md), and keep the stamp as the marker for them.
donts: Don't use a grey KPI-tile dashboard with a blue accent; that is the category default this world refuses.
Don't introduce a fifth register-bar hue or reuse violet, red or green outside their jobs.
Don't add shadows to sheets or cards; hover and selection do not lift.
Don't apply these tokens to the gateway, Citizen or Ward Officer views; they remain on the older teal theme in `src/index.css` (known scope boundary).
Don't hard-code colours or fonts in corporator CSS, or load fonts from outside `public/fonts/`.
